title: Reports ON gives access to the Reports page with all reports (no per-report on/off)
preconds: 1. A user has a role with the Reports toggle (under Page Access) ON.
steps:
1. Log in as that user and look at the top navigation.
  2. Click Reports in the top navigation.
  3. Look at the list of reports.
expected:
Reports is shown in the top navigation.

All reports are listed together.

There is no way to switch individual reports on or off; Reports is all-or-nothing.
